scope: Read-only exact proposal delta and path/alias/permission/race/injection analysis. No application/helpers/tests edits or workloads run.
mechanical_proof: Reversing only ordinary_descendant initialization and selected resolved_store expression/comments restores original entire layout source exactly. All other methods, guard, candidate resolve and containment unchanged.
decision: Eligible only within normal frozen ProjectLayout invariant: native path root is normalized absolute by __post_init__, fixed .orqalis child, exact base type and ordinary descendant. This is not arbitrary root mutation/custom Path behavior or error chronology equivalence.
conclusions: Subclasses start ordinary_descendant=False, retain self.store dispatch and both original filesystem resolves. Atypical absolute escapes/relative parent traversal also retain original store.resolve.

For normal base descendants, root post-init already canonicalizes/anchors input; .orqalis is fixed child. Full fresh candidate lstat ancestry guard still rejects root/store/descendant symlink and junction before candidate.resolve and containment.

Candidate.resolve still observes actual filesystem path. If an ancestor changes to a link after guard, candidate resolving outside original lexical store is denied; omitting store.resolve does not permit that outside path simply because prefix and candidate both newly resolve outside.
Missing regular descendants still use strict=False candidate resolution and lexical containment. No root/path metadata cache, trusted caller snapshot or global atomicity added.
explicit_limits: Dataclass root is frozen, but deliberate object.__setattr__ bypass with relative root or absolute .. components breaks normal invariant: proposed lexical resolved_store can produce PolicyDenied false rejection where previous store.resolve normalized it. No security bypass identified; do not claim mutation compatibility.

Path subclasses/custom resolve implementations and monkeypatched prefix-specific resolve faults can observe omitted call. Exact-type ProjectLayout does not imply native Path type. Native-root eligibility guard plus absolute/no-parent lexical checks can retain fallback if these atypical behaviors must be supported.

Windows store casing is compared by platform Path semantics. Symlink/junction aliases denied by fresh guard; candidate resolve remains authoritative. Exotic remaining aliases can produce stronger rejection rather than broaden lexical containment. No exhaustive Windows alias equivalence proven without fixtures.

Metadata/permission error precedence and concurrent transient observations can differ because one resolution is omitted. Unexpected errors in retained ancestry guard/candidate resolution remain fail closed; no guarantee of identical every-injected-error behavior.
Existing guard/resolve/IO TOCTOU limits remain; no race-free storage claim.
Unapplied at inspection, targeted tests pending. Earlier single passive2.921s diagnostic is not original5s acceptance or speedup proof. No full14/full86/two-round/installed/release readiness claim.
recommended_validation: Native absolute ordinary/empty/missing descendants and candidate escape denial
Real root/store/parent/target symlink and junction denied by full fresh guard
Controlled ancestor swap between guard and resolve fails outside-store containment
Subclasses and absolute/traversal fallback retain both resolves/custom store dispatch
Unexpected lstat/candidate resolve permission failures propagate before IO; prefix-specific injected fault omission explicitly characterized
Windows ordinary casing and any supported short/drive aliases; false-denial characterization if deliberately altered roots are tested
optional_conservative_gate: If atypical root compatibility is required, skip store.resolve only for native Path root with is_absolute and no .. components; otherwise retain old resolution. This is lexical eligibility, not a cache or new filesystem trust check.
